crossRefs.note: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?
Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will…

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: There was war again. David went out, and fought with the Philistines, and killed them with a great slaughter; and they fled before him.
translations.bsb: When war broke out again, David went out and fought the Philistines and struck them with such a mighty blow that they fled before him.
translations.kjv: And there was war again: and David went out, and fought with the Philistines, and slew them with a great slaughter; and they fled from him.
translations.asv: And there was war again: and David went out, and fought with the Philistines, and slew them with a great slaughter; and they fled before him.
